deviations.claim_in_article: “The idea was that those carrying the cargo would repay the money the United States spends to keep the strait safe.”
deviations.issue: The article identifies cargo carriers as the parties who would repay the costs, although the Ledger says the proposal did not specify who would pay.
deviations.explanation: HF-003 says the proposal did not identify the payer. Naming cargo carriers adds a specific, unsupported term to the proposal; the wording still presents it as an idea, not as an implemented charge.

deviations.claim_in_article: “with its distant danger reaching gasoline prices and the cost of moving goods through crude oil.”
deviations.issue: The article asserts downstream effects on gasoline prices and the cost of moving goods, which the Ledger does not establish.
deviations.explanation: This extends the reported Brent-market observations to gasoline and goods-transport costs and asserts a causal link through crude oil without Ledger support.
deviations.qualifier_text: “briefly narrowed” and “at the time of reporting”
